profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer - Technology Services and Solutions
profile.summary:
Currently developing mission critical software to handle emergency 9-1-1 calls and dispatch operations in Silicon Valley. The software is used by 9-1-1 operators to manage call information, provide medical triage, coordinate radio communication, and dispatch ambulances and fire trucks for local government.

In other words:  If an employee at Google or Apple has a heart attack.... my computer program will make sure the ambulance reaches them in time.

Over 25 years of experience, primarily in Java and Visual Studio.Net. Highly skilled in object-oriented architecture, troubleshooting complex information systems, and translating business requirements into program specifications. Experienced entrepreneur with five software patents pending.

patents.title: Method and System for Generation of a Representation Symbol providing an Identification Authorization
patents.description: ABSTRACT:  Provided is a system and method for generating a representation of a symbol. The method includes receiving a base image symbol. The base image symbol is distinguished into a plurality of initial image components. The initial image components are mapped to a first plane defined by two perpendicular axes, a third axis being normal to the plane. A noise function is selected. A plurality of views are generated, each by applying the selected noise function to each initial image component to provide an adjusted image component, each adjusted image component offset from initial image component. The adjusted image components are collectively orthogonally projected into a viewing plane angled relative to the first plane. The plurality of views are output such as to a database or a display. An associated system for performing the method is also provided.
